results.title: Ahrefs Brand Radar Alternative | MentionBird
results.content:
MentionBird suits teams who know which questions decide their sales and want to be told which answer to fix first, not just where they rank. It fits brands that need more prompts than a bundle allows, sell into more than one country, and would rather fix one losing answer this week than assemble a plan from a dashboard. [...] Is MentionBird a good Ahrefs Brand Radar alternative?

Both tools track the prompts you choose and run them daily, so the question is what you need after the run. Brand Radar is stronger on research, with a 462 million prompt index and the Ahrefs suite behind every cited domain. MentionBird is stronger on the step after, turning one answer into a specific plan, without metering you by the check.

What counts as a check in Ahrefs Brand Radar?

One prompt, on one platform, in one country, for one run. Ten prompts across three platforms tracked daily is 900 checks a month. Claude costs eight checks per update. Anything past your allowance bills as overage, at $0.020 per check.

Do I need an Ahrefs subscription to use Brand Radar? [...] Brand Radar is built for the wide view. It tracks your AI visibility, helps you benchmark yourself against competitors, and draws on a huge prompt database built from real search demand, so you can see where you stand across search, AI answers, YouTube, and TikTok in one place. Where it stops is providing direction on its own. MentionBird picks up each answer that left you out, across any platform ranging from ChatGPT to DeepSeek, reads the sources cited instead of you, and turns that into specific marketing tasks: the page to write, the one to fix, the roundup to get into.
